title: Map legacy CONT_MASTER rows to the modern contact shape with batch conversion
target_requirement: Deliver migrated.py exposing convert_contact(row) -> dict | None and convert_all(rows) -> list[dict] that map legacy CONT_MASTER rows to the modern 11-key contact shape per target_spec.md: PREF_CH code enum with blank defaulting to 'email', OPTOUT_FLG to marketing_optout bool, empty EMAIL_TX to None, sentinel dates to None, snake_case key rename; convert_all drops soft-deleted rows and preserves input order.
expected_behavior: convert_contact returns None for DEL_FLG='Y' and otherwise a dict with exactly the 11 modern keys; PREF_CH E/P/M/blank map to email/phone/mail/email; OPTOUT_FLG 'Y' maps to True and 'N'/blank to False; blank EMAIL_TX maps to None; convert_all([r1, deleted, r3]) returns converted r1 then r3 with no None entries.
provenance: Synthetic; authored for LegacyCRM-Bench from Meridian CRM 4.2 spec (SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md §1).
security_expectations: No network access; module must not import network or subprocess modules; soft-deleted contacts must never be emitted by convert_all.
failure_conditions: Emitting soft-deleted contacts; reordering rows in convert_all; defaulting blank PREF_CH to anything but 'email'; leaking legacy column names; nondeterminism or I/O.
